notes.title: Free prologue with new boss and secret mission!
notes.content:
Greetings!

We are excited to present the new and mysterious free game Union of Gnomes: Prologue. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960560/Union_of_Gnomes_Prologue/

It combines the creepy atmosphere of dark fantasy, cheerful humor, and, of course, the daring gnomes desperately fighting for their freedom and independence. 
 
[previewyoutube=atZ26XQlAEQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Lead a motley crew of guerrillas to free your captured comrades and escape the tyranny of the ruthless Snow White. For the tenacious players, we've hidden a secret quest within the prologue—conquering it will bring you closer to solving the mystery of the eighth gnome! Look for the clue in the video!

Here's what you'll find in the game:

 One new, unique and terribly dangerous mission!
 A dangerous new boss!
 A secret quest!
 A lot of well-known – and not so well-known – fairy tale characters who fight on the side of evil, trying to suppress and destroy the gnomes!
 Create unusual combos with your gnome cards to reach the end of the prologue or die with honor!

Once you've finished the prologue (and added Union of Gnomes to your Steam Wishlist), you can look forward to the full story of the gnomes' heroic adventures as they fight for their freedom in the full game. The gnomes stand for freedom and the right not to impose subjugation on anyone else!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097030/Union_of_Gnomes/ 

Don't forget to recommend the game to your friends and favorite streamers, share your impressions, and leave a review. 

Freedom to Gnomes!
Union of Gnomes Team

notes.title: Changes to the Gravewood High Early Access Roadmap
notes.content:
Dear students and concerned parents! 

We want to make you aware of several changes to the school's development plan, which, however, won't stop you from getting the most out of your education and experience at Gravewood High. 

The long-awaited full release of Gravewood High is just around the corner! At last, you'll discover all the mysteries of the creepy school, and just who Mr. Hyde is and why he does what he does. 

We have combined two of the smaller levels into a larger one to optimize the development process, give you access to new content as soon as possible, and implement all the ideas we have for the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37767751/40e8455cff4ffa83e6e6a980b6e5c86ec23219ff.jpg

What will be in the final level of Gravewood High:

 A few hours of exciting and intense gameplay filled with danger and brain-blowing puzzles.
 Brand-new locations you haven't seen before. There will be classes, dungeons, and something else as well. 
 New gameplay mechanics and improvements to existing mechanics.
 The origin of Mr. Hyde. 
 The beloved Teacher will be able to teleport, break down walls, set new clever traps, and much more. 
 Mr. Hyde's little helpers! And no, these are not other students. Instead, they are brand-new characters in the game, getting to know them is guaranteed to cost you a few nerve cells.
 You can use teleportation. This feature will help you to avoid traps and the clutches of Mr. Hyde. 
 Two endings, which will depend entirely on your choices, so read all the notes and clues carefully. 

The School Board promises that no student will leave Gravewood High disappointed. Mr. Hyde will personally take care of everyone and create a unique atmosphere of fun at the school. 

Add Gravewood High to your Wishlist and join our Discord to stay tuned. Gravewood High will soon reveal its true self to the world! 

See you at the creepy school,
Gravewood High School Board

notes.title: Update Gravewood High to access a new trap, spooky rooms, and more!
notes.content:
Dear students and concerned parents! 

We have released a brand new patch for Gravewood High. Mr Hyde is waiting for you… with a new trap. Be careful not to touch the wire. If you do, the bell will ring and it will alert the Teacher.
 

When Mr. Hyde hears the bell, he will rush to the alarm and snatch up every clumsy student trying to sneak in (or out) of the school. Be sure to practice your agility and dexterity to avoid the well-placed trap.

Those of you with a keen eye would have noticed that the trap already appeared in level 1 of Gravewood High.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37767751/3379ecec9c3e506addeee7c2a5a45ba71fec492e.png

There's also a new puzzle in the science exhibition classroom. If you can solve it, you'll gain access to a secret room, which will reveal a little more about the mystery of the spooky school.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37767751/92dcb4a490fc776ecc7bb695011d78fc8066fd6f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37767751/98c1d42e63a84fdef0353ee41fa8e5853594b1ca.png

We've finished updating the design of the rooms on the first level. There are additional details that add to the game's atmosphere and make the environment more interesting and varied.

In addition, we've also: 

 Added a new secret achievement.
 Fixed inverted graphics settings sliders (now they work as they should).

We are hard at work on the next Gravewood High update – have a look at our Roadmap here. You won't have to wait long for it!

Join our Discord and stay tuned for future updates. After all, Mr. Hyde misses his favorite students.

See you at the creepy school,
Gravewood High School Board.

notes.title: Updated Early Access Roadmap
notes.content:
Dear students and concerned parents,

Below you can view the list of updates planned for the game while it remains in Early Access.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37767751/0e096b9a8fb6fd5154a5c9cea3d7a616e1063550.png

Early Access Features

 Level 1, which consists of 5 different segments. The average time of one playthrough is 1-2 hours.
 A basic version of the room layout generator and puzzle randomization, which increase the amount of unique playthroughs.
 First player power - destroying walls and objects.
 Mr. Hyde remains in his human form, but there are several nasty traps in his arsenal, so watch out! 

Quality of Life Update
Once Early Access players have played through Gravewood High, we will begin to collect feedback. Any reported bugs will be fixed and we will incorporate further improvements to the game.
While we have worked tirelessly on the title, there may be a few unplanned anomalies. You can submit anything that seems strange or bizarre to us through our forums, email, or social media channels; things that you find hilarious are also welcome!

Multiplayer update

Release the alpha version of the 2-6 player co-op multiplayer mode. Help each other against the Teacher, or frame other players so that you can escape the school alone. Earn ranks at the end of each round, such as 'Savior' or 'Teacher's Little Helper' – in the future, these ranke will affect the player's reputation system. 
Adding new puzzles and riddles for multiplayer mode. 
A large new map with unique areas, such as a gym, locker rooms, and more.
Additional mobility the Teacher so that he can now jump over low obstacles, like tables and through window openings. 

First content update
Multiplayer:

 Improvements to the multiplayer progress system
 Bug fixes

Base game:

 A new puzzle related to the science exhibition in segment 2.
 Mr. Hyde will obtain a new trap - a small bell, which will ring loudly if you are not careful. 
 Improved visuals. We will continue to work on lighting, item placement and the interiors of various rooms.

Level 2 Release

 Level 2, consisting of a completely new, previously inaccessible location. This will add an additional 1-2 hours per playthrough.
 Improvements to Level 1. Updated room layout generator and improved puzzle randomization, which will further diversify playthroughs.
 Brand new puzzles and secrets!
 New game mechanics and improvements to existing ones. Players will be able to cut chains, neutralize traps, and more.
 The addition of a character leveling mechanic, which will depend on the number of items collected. It will be possible to increase your inventory space or movement speed among other things. 
 Mr. Hyde will change his appearance to something more sinister, gaining new traps and abilities in the process.
 The Teacher can create barriers, encouraging the player to find ways to break them down or look for alternative routes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37767751/0c1e1772da856cfdc95828e0b72429e83a55dd58.png
Content Update 2

 Improvements to Level 2. An updated algorithm for generating rooms, more room layout options and improved puzzle randomization, which will further diversify playthroughs.
 New puzzles and secrets! 
 New horrific abilities for Mr. Hyde. We have played with a few abilities during development and plan to introduce a few to the final game. A teaser of what we’ve been working on behind the scenes:
              - "Leech" ability - Mr. Hyde spawns a gruesome creature that chases the player and slows them down. 
              - "Tracking" ability  - the Teacher is able to trail his prey by following the player’s footprints.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37767751/85bc15ec32f026c216995e827361698535df13c7.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37767751/07e5668752adca731262f36fda4f9ae79b7c488f.png

Full Release

 Level 3, consisting of a completely new location. This will add an additional 1.5 hours of playtime to each playthrough.
 Improvements to Level 3. An updated algorithm for generating rooms and improved puzzle randomization.
 Mr. Hyde will unleash his final ghastly appearance. Are you brave enough to witness the Teacher’s true form? 
 Mr. Hyde will be able to teleport around the school building, catching the unsuspecting player.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37767751/1ce7f8d5b40dc5674ac16758b3e4e9b690260822.png

notes.title: Bug fixes and new horror elements added!
notes.content:
Dear students and concerned parents,

We are ecstatic that everyone is enjoying the school's various activities and classes! Thank you for all of the feedback we received during Gravewood High's Early Access release. Every bit helps and we've already started implementing some of it in the form of the Bugfix update.

Here is the list of changes and tweaks:

[olist]
 Fixed and added FPS settings: 30, 60, 90, 120, 144, and unlimited.
 Added a VSync option.
 Expanded adjustments for gamepad and mouse sensitivity.
 Fixed the game displaying the "Save Settings?" message before the game resolution is changed.
 Increased View Distance on lower settings.
 Changes to the counterweight drop in the clock tower.
 Additional horror elements added throughout the first level.
 Added more randomization to some of the puzzles. For example, the one in the music classroom.
 Finished an optimization pass, so that the game runs even better.
 The duration of the hint for throwing objects with the "G" key was extended.
 Fixed an issue where the Teacher would get stuck in doors occasionally.
 Centered the light from the flashlight.
 Fixed a bug with the mouse control, which would get stuck occasionally when relaunching the game. You should be able to freely move the mouse vertically and horizontally now.
[/olist]

Please continue to leave any comments or bug reports in the Steam Discussions or on the official Gravewood High Discord. 

Next week, we will show how your cool ideas become a part of the class schedule!


See you soon at the creepy school,
Gravewood High School Council

notes.title: Do not tamper with the CCTV system
notes.content:
Dear students and concerned parents,

We would like to squash any rumors and state, for the record, that the security system at Gravewood High is working as intended. CCTV cameras are positioned in particularly long and dark corridors to ensure that school rules are followed – they record every violation that takes place.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37767751/5c92a6c0b851064bf9fa01939db94902ffed81b2.jpg

Mr. Hyde is monitoring all of the camera footage. As soon as he spots a student where they should not be, he will set off the alarm and rush to the offender's location. To minimize disruption in the school, we advise all students to stay out of sight of the cameras.

Please remember the following rules:

 It is forbidden to navigate through a camera's blind spot.
 It is forbidden to throw objects at cameras to disable them.
 It is forbidden to tamper with the camera remote in the security office, or to shut them off.

All students will be closely monitored to ensure no part of the school is vandalized.

See you soon at the creepy school,
Gravewood High School Board

notes.title: Alpha 2 is live! Be the first to outsmart the Teacher
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37767751/51e7767bd0e0f6da53aa352d093edd024f2f0559.png

Dear students,

Gravewood High opens its doors again. A dark maze of school corridors awaits, illuminated by the pale light of security cameras — Mr. Hyde’s keen eyes. The Teacher walks around tirelessly, ready to catch and detain every intruder.

For all the freshmen out there, who have never stepped foot in our esteemed establishment, here are the instructions on how to download and play the Alpha 2 build. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37767751/0f58757a743e545f9e1ffc772571b19f30f200c5.gif


 Make sure that you have an up to date Steam client. 
 Press the “Download Demo” button on the game’s Steam page.
 Add the game to your wishlist now and be the first to discover the horrifying mysteries of Gravewood High! Also, learn about upcoming contests with cool prizes.

The secret passages have been walled up, all of the keys hidden. Unless you are smart enough to unlock the new teleportation ability or have a secret friend on the outside, you will NEVER get out. We will make sure that everyone gets what they deserve.

Gravewood High School Board

P.S. Read all the way to the end? You are wonderful! Here’s a reward - a code to unlock one of the *special* lockers inside the game that contain useful items: 803
